description:
Ten years into his career. Eui-Hyeon is an unknown actor who takes on any role given to him without complaint. One cold autumn night, after enduring another grueling shoot without a single word of complaint as usual, Eui-Hyeon happens to meet the world-famous star Cha Il-Ju.

 *“That's right. You're Eui-Hyeon, aren't you?”*

Top star Cha Il-Ju, an issue-maker since his debut, felt like someone from another world to Eui-Hyeon, even though they were both actors. It was clearly meant to be just a fleeting encounter...

 *“If you're free, wanna grab a drink?”
“I don't waste effort on people I'm not interested in either.”*

Cha Il-Ju's unhesitating approach gradually begins to shift Eui-Hyeon's world. A precious person who comes to him first, without needing any special effort. A benefactor who recognized his unwavering passion and relentless effort, even after years of obscurity. 

 *“It'll be fine. I promise I won't get greedy.”*

But the feelings that had begun to stir were steadily changing, contrary to Eui-Hyeon's resolve.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
